newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian navy sells three minesweepers to France.
newsitem.headline: Belgian navy sells three minesweepers to France.

text.p: Belgium's navy has sold three of its 10 minesweepers to France as part of defence cuts announced in 1992, the armed forces press office said in a statement on Tuesday.
Terms were not disclosed at the request of France's defence ministry.
The three vessels, the M918 Dianthus, M919 Fuchia and M920 Iris, will be incorporated in the French navy under the names Verseau, Cephee and Capricorne and based in Brest.
The minesweepers, developed jointly with France and the Netherlands in the 1980s, were put up for sale in 1993 along with a navy frigate, surplus tanks, airforce jets and other equipment.
A Belgian armed forces spokesman said, however, the frigate was now destined to be scrapped and was no longer for sale.
